MT212 (cgn1): the scalar-to-layerwise gap also appears on a GroupNorm ResNet-18, which has no batch statistics; GAP-REPLICATES, Goal met. MT215 (cuc1): without augmentation on CIFAR-100, tuned SGD still beats the best MetaOptimize cell, by +12.18 pp; DEFICIT-HOLDS, Goal met. title: cvt4 and cvt5 imported as MT222 and MT223 (both Goal met), 30 runs linked

Under the notebook's outcome rules both are Goal met, as MT219 was: each registered branch answers its question and the tested account is in band on every registered band (9 for cvt4, 8 for cvt5). The bounds stay on the records. For cvt4, HOLDHIGH's complement collapsed too, so a direct stall is not separated from one through the complement, and there is no time gate or dose curve. For cvt5, the level-holds stamps sit only 0.96-1.34 pp inside READ_BAR, K13's step size hovers near the floor rather than freezing, and K13's level settled before its pin. The 18 intervention runs (cvt4's step-size holds HOLDLOW, HOLDSHARED, HOLDHIGH and HOLDHEAD; cvt5's vote weights K13 and K33) are marked on their run pages and listed in results/CORPUS-EXCLUSIONS.tsv. The 30 runs link to their records with sanitized raw logs, for 3,049 runs in total. No existing row was amended. title: cvt6 and cvt7 imported as MT224 (Mixed) and MT225 (Goal met), 36 runs linked
detail: MT224 imports the cvt6 row and MT225 the cvt7 row, from MASTER-TABLE lines 224-225 (CORRECTIONS 246 and 247). cvt6 returned GRADED on PlainNet18_c100: with tensor 50 on MUTE's large replayed trajectory and the complement forced open-loop onto HEAD's recorded path, the arm sits at the k01 location (HIGHHEADPATH 11.49 vs k01 12.07); with 50 at the floor and the complement forced onto MUTE's collapse schedule, it sits between (LOWMUTEPATH 41.56); the complement-hold control keeps HEAD's level (P_50 +53.53 pp = +94.40 SE, P_C +23.47 pp = +41.38 SE). It is Mixed under the notebook's outcome rules, as MT218 and MT221 were: the branch answers the question, but no registered account fits every band (GRADED's own account hits 3 of 5), so the pattern is one no account predicted. No single-route sentence and no necessity is licensed. cvt7 returned TRANSFERS-GRADED on ResNet18_c100: holding ISO's three-carrier group on k01's measured trajectory costs about 20 pp of the 47 pp rescue (HOLDHIGH 50.23 vs ISO 70.04, P_HIGH +19.81 pp = +34.94 SE), while the floor and ISO's own trajectory keep ISO's level. It is Goal met, as MT219 and MT222 were: the returned account hits every registered band, the positive control reproduces and no prior was stated. Its bounds stay on the record: dose and held set are confounded with network, and the free complement did not stay ISO-like, so direct vs via-complement is not separated on ResNet. The 24 intervention runs are marked on their run pages and listed in results/CORPUS-EXCLUSIONS.tsv; cvt6's three forced arms carry two holds, and each shows its second (COMP_HOLD) witness line from its own log. The landing's in-place corrections of its own registrations (CORRECTIONS 242's RULE H run count, 242.14, 242.3(2) and 243.4's cross-reference) are shown on MT224 and MT225. The runners jobs/run_cifar_cvt6.sh and jobs/run_cifar_cvt7.sh exist only on the cluster, so both records carry a source-unavailable warning. The 36 runs link to their records with sanitized raw logs, for 3,085 runs in total. No existing row was amended. Research outcomes are now 50 Goal met, 41 Goal missed, 30 Mixed and 23 Open.

title: cvt8 and cvt9 imported as MT226 and MT227 (both Mixed), 42 runs linked
detail: MT226 imports the cvt8 row and MT227 the cvt9 row, from MASTER-TABLE lines 226-227 (CORRECTIONS 252 and 253, campaign commit ba01f54). cvt8 returned DOSE-FULL+ROUTE-PARTIAL+BIGROUTE-DIRECT on ResNet18_c100: holding ISO's three carriers on PlainNet's dose with the complement free puts the run at the k01 location (HOLDBIG 19.38 vs k01 23.06), while k01's own dose gives cvt7's partial loss again (HOLDHIGH 49.63; P_DOSE +30.25 pp = +53.85 SE), so cvt7's dose confound is resolved toward dose; forcing ISO's complement path recovers +8.56 pp of the loss at k01's dose and nothing at PlainNet's dose (BIGISOPATH 19.42). Both big-dose arms sit below k01 on every seed (3.36-3.90 pp), so these are locations, and a recovery under 5 pp cannot be seen between them. cvt9 returned DOSE-GRADED and WINDOW-GRADED on PlainNet18_c100: with the complement forced onto HEADPATH, the level falls through two in-between states over the three rungs tried (MIDDOSE 55.86, RESDOSE 21.84) to the k01 location (HIGHHEADPATH 11.21), and either half of the large trajectory alone gives a large partial loss (EARLY 18.37, LATE 27.71; LATE - EARLY +9.34 pp = +15.31 SE). One 2.92 pp move would turn that whole FINAL into REPLICATE-FAILED. Both are Mixed under the notebook's outcome rules, as MT218, MT221 and MT224 were: each branch answers its question and the controls reproduce, but no registered account fits every band (cvt8's three DOSE accounts hit 6 of 7; cvt9's DOSE-GRADED account misses MIDDOSE's band by 5.86 pp and WINDOW-GRADED's misses EARLY by 1.63 pp). MT226 also records two text defects in the cvt8 scorer, reported under RULE 16, that reach no gate. The landing's in-place correction of cvt9's registration (249.3's LATE integral, truncated as 4.06479e7, is 4.06480e7) is shown on MT227. The 33 intervention runs are marked on their run pages and listed in results/CORPUS-EXCLUSIONS.tsv: cvt8's three forced arms carry a group hold and a rest-group hold, cvt9's six held arms a step-size and a complement hold, and EARLY and LATE a third, update-window hold; every further hold shows its own witness line from the run's log. Both runners were archived at registration and are linked. The 42 runs link to their records with sanitized raw logs, for 3,127 runs in total. No existing row was amended and no earlier record moved. Research outcomes are now 50 Goal met, 41 Goal missed, 32 Mixed and 23 Open.

title: MT226 reason and MT227 scope: wording corrected after the cvt8 / cvt9 final audit
detail: The final audit of the cvt8 and cvt9 landing (CORRECTIONS 253.15, campaign commit 3cf4201) found three wording slips. No number, gate, token, outcome or Corrected badge moves; MT226 and MT227 stay Mixed. (1) MT227: MASTER-TABLE row 227 said DOSE-GRADED changes on one arm only if RESDOSE rises about 39 pp. The registered decide() returns DOSE-NONMONOTONE whenever RESDOSE - MIDDOSE > 5, so MIDDOSE falling by more than 39.02 pp flips the word too. Row 227 was corrected in place to name both routes, with the superseded wording kept in its bracket; MT227's scope now carries the corrected sentence and a documented amendment warning. (2) MT226's reason, and the import note J-ee90c736-54a0-49c4-9617-dfa8dead501c, said forcing ISO's complement path recovers nothing at PlainNet's dose. The record (CORRECTIONS 252.8) says the carriers alone reproduce HOLDBIG's stall there, but both arms sit below k01, so a recovery under 5 pp could not be seen, and this is not evidence that the free complement's collapse plays no role in HOLDBIG. (3) The same reason and note said cvt8's three DOSE accounts hit 6 of 7. CORRECTIONS 252.3 lists four DOSE-family accounts: three hit 6 of 7 and DOSE x VIA hits 5. The notebook now reads research revision 3cf4201.

title: Imported the cwd3 landing: the carriers' own weight decay
detail: MASTER-TABLE line 236 is imported as MT236 from campaign commit 97eb049 (CORRECTIONS 278), with the 15 runs of the 064dff6 ingest and 12 new exclusion rows under the existing decay-mask kind. It is Goal met under the documented rules: it returns its registered branch and its registered state word in the registered direction, the scorer exits with every gate passing, the in-batch reference reproduces the earlier network-wide result, the bite gate excludes on records the broken-mask null that would have produced the opposite verdict, and no registered account misses a band and no control fails. Switching the coupled weight decay off on the three carrier normalization scales alone, 1,536 of 11.2 million parameters, removes the collapse as fully as switching it off on all twenty does, while two matched non-carrier sets at the same depth stay on the floor. The record leads with what bounds it: both control readings are locations at the floor and therefore bounds rather than measured zeros, the residual left to the other seventeen scales is bounded in the other direction and its sign is horizon-dependent, the descriptive ratio drifts through one so no share may be read off it, and neither position class nor a count-and-dose account is separated from the carriers' identity. This landing amended no row anywhere, so no earlier outcome moves and no Corrected badge is set.

title: Imported the cwd4 and cwd5 landings: which carriers, and at which weight decay
detail: MASTER-TABLE lines 237 and 238 are imported as MT237 and MT238 from campaign commits 26baf4a (CORRECTIONS 283) and 8554afa (CORRECTIONS 285), with the 48 runs of the 8b9fbd2 and 91fcd57 ingests, 18 new exclusion rows under the existing decay-mask kind, and 21 under the base-weight-decay kind. Three of those 21 are the first rows in the corpus to deviate on two axes at once, and they are listed with both. Both records are Mixed under the documented rules, and neither is Goal met by default: the MT218 to MT236 precedent grants Goal met only when the fired account returns its registered branch and its registered state word in the registered direction, no registered account misses a band, and no control fails. MT237 answers its question and refutes the count-and-dose rival at a matched count of two, but the account that fired had predicted the non-sufficing carrier at the anchor's floor and it landed about thirty points above it, and the second branch token clears its bar by four tenths of a standard error, which the record itself calls descriptive. MT238 hits every registered band on the four-rung ladder and no control fails, but the batch's second registered question, whether the carrier account still holds wherever the collapse still exists, cannot be answered here: the companion arm was registered to be read only if its rung collapsed, and it did not. Both records lead with what bounds them. The floor readings are locations and therefore bounds rather than measured zeros; four rungs can only bracket a change between one decade lower and the campaign's own weight decay and can never locate it, so no threshold value may be named; and the term-magnitude and position-class rivals remain unseparated. Neither landing amended a row anywhere, so no earlier outcome moves and no Corrected badge is set.

title: Imported the caw2 and cgw1 landings: the standard recipe, and the audit at standard weight decay
detail: MASTER-TABLE lines 239 and 240 are imported as MT239 and MT240 from campaign commit 8a99001 (CORRECTIONS 295 and 296), with the 67 runs of the joint 477a853 ingest and 46 new exclusion rows: 12 under the base-momentum kind, 28 under the base-weight-decay kind, and six that deviate on both kinds at once. Those six are the first rows in the corpus to carry two base-optimiser flag deviations, and they are listed once with both flags named. MT239 is Mixed, as MT238: the standard AdamW plus Adam recipe does not collapse at the mechanism cell and every predicted band is hit, but the dose arm reached only about a seventeenth of the collapsing control's realised weight shrink, so whether the recipe survives the control's dose is undecided, and the base swap cannot be separated from the lower dose it produces. MT240 is Open, as MT183: on the audit's core cell the uniform-over-aligned gap at the standard decay value 5e-4 lies between its registered cutoffs, so only its interval is reported, while a single shared step size beats both partitions there by 2.6 to 2.8 points. Both records lead with what bounds them: one cell each, three seeds or four, and a harness whose 5e-4 decays the weights far less than a standard recipe, so neither settles whether the audit's effect depends on unusual decay. Neither landing amended a row, so no earlier outcome moves and no Corrected badge is set. The campaign's path decision (CORRECTIONS 297) is recorded in the campaign repository, not here.
